summary: Iteration 5 backend testing — 100% pass. Added /app/backend/tests/test_iter5_features.py with 22 tests covering all 17 items in the spec: medicines shop (list/detail/order/orders-mine + category filter + 404), lab tests (list/detail/book/bookings-mine + 404), blogs (list/detail with full body + 404), AI diet plan (Claude Sonnet 4.5 generates non-empty plan ~10s + /diet-plans returns it), doctor onboarding (doctor/me returns pending entry with verified=false, doctor/onboard updates with onboarded_at + documents_uploaded=true, my-appointments initially [] then shows appointment after admin approves and patient books, my-patients dedups by patient with visits count), push (register-push returns 201 with status='pending' when key is placeholder — does NOT crash, admin/broadcast returns {sent_to: N}). All 22 new + 58 existing tests pass — 80/80 total in 45.54s against the public preview URL (https://swasth-daily.preview.emergentagent.com). No red flags. Backend endpoints validated: response schemas, price math (2*p1+1*p2 == order.total), status codes (200/201/400/401/403/404), MongoDB _id exclusion, per-user scoping, auth requirements, admin-only guards.

_push_client uses PUSH_KEY captured at import time. If EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY changes at deploy without process restart, header stays stale. Acceptable for MVP because deployment restarts the process.
POST /api/register-push takes user_id in the body without auth — anyone can register a device_token for any user_id. Consider requiring auth and deriving user_id from the JWT.
